Searching for `store.<Type>` usages outside the `store` package and counting distinct importing packages (directories):

- `store.User` is referenced in 7 packages: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go`, `server/auth/context.go`), `server/notification` (`server/notification/email.go`), `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/api/v1` (many files, e.g. `server/router/api/v1/user_service.go`, `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go`), `server/router/api/v1/test`.
